name: salicylic acid
role: Unclogs pores and reduces inflammatory acne by exfoliating inside the follicle.
caution: Can irritate dry or sensitized skin; introduce gradually, 2-3 times a week at first.

name: niacinamide
role: Regulates sebum production and evens skin tone; well tolerated by nearly all skin types.
caution: Generally safe to pair with other actives.

name: retinol
role: Increases cell turnover; treats both acne and post-acne texture over time.
caution: Evening use only; increases sun sensitivity, always follow with SPF the next morning.

name: benzoyl peroxide
role: Kills the acne-causing bacteria C. acnes; effective against inflammatory breakouts.
caution: Bleaches fabric and towels; drying at higher concentrations.

name: hyaluronic acid
role: Draws water into the skin surface, improving hydration without adding oil.
caution: Apply to damp skin and seal with a moisturiser, or it can pull moisture from deeper layers in dry climates.

name: ascorbic acid
role: Antioxidant that brightens post-acne marks and supports collagen.
caution: Unstable in light and air; store in a cool, dark place and use within a few months of opening.

name: zinc oxide
role: Broad-spectrum UV protection; also has mild anti-inflammatory properties.
caution: Mineral formulas can leave a visible cast on deeper skin tones -- tinted versions reduce this.

name: zinc pca
role: Helps balance oil production, often paired with niacinamide in oily-skin formulas.
caution: Generally well tolerated.

name: glycerin
role: Draws and holds moisture in the skin; a base-level hydrator in most cleansers and moisturisers.
caution: Generally well tolerated.

name: panthenol
role: Calms irritation and supports the skin barrier, often used after exfoliating actives.
caution: Generally well tolerated.

name: titanium dioxide
role: Broad-spectrum UV protection, often paired with zinc oxide in mineral sunscreens.
caution: Can leave a cast on deeper skin tones; tinted formulas reduce this.

name: fragrance
role: Scent only -- provides no skincare benefit.
caution: One of the most common contact allergens; always excluded when listed as an allergy.

name: citric acid
role: Mild exfoliant at higher concentrations; also used at low levels to adjust product pH.
caution: Generally well tolerated at the low concentrations used in most formulas.

name: lactic acid
role: Exfoliates and supports the skin's natural moisture-retaining factors; gentler than glycolic acid.
caution: Can irritate sensitive skin or a compromised skin barrier; introduce gradually.

name: glycolic acid
role: Chemical exfoliant that dissolves dead skin cells, improving texture and post-acne marks.
caution: Can irritate sensitive skin or a compromised skin barrier; increases sun sensitivity.

name: mandelic acid
role: Gentle exfoliant and brightening agent; larger molecule size makes it milder than glycolic acid.
caution: Can irritate sensitive skin or a compromised skin barrier, though less often than smaller AHAs.

name: phytic acid
role: Gentle exfoliant with antioxidant properties; helps brighten and even skin tone.
caution: Generally well tolerated.

name: gluconolactone
role: Polyhydroxy acid; exfoliates the skin surface with less irritation than AHAs, suits sensitive skin.
caution: Generally well tolerated, including on reactive skin.

name: tartaric acid
role: Exfoliant that supports skin-cell turnover and evens tone; often paired with other AHAs.
caution: Can irritate a compromised skin barrier.

name: adenosine
role: Calms and restores skin, with evidence for reducing fine lines and redness alongside acne.
caution: Generally well tolerated.

name: sodium ascorbyl phosphate
role: Stable form of vitamin C; brightens tone and has mild antimicrobial benefits against acne bacteria.
caution: Generally well tolerated; more stable than pure ascorbic acid.

name: zinc gluconate
role: Zinc salt with anti-inflammatory and oil-regulating properties, similar to zinc PCA.
caution: Generally well tolerated.

name: sulfur
role: Long-used acne ingredient; calms inflammation and has mild antibacterial and exfoliating action.
caution: Strong smell; can be drying at higher concentrations.

name: lactobacillus ferment
role: Supports a balanced skin microbiome, which can help calm acne-related redness over time.
caution: Generally well tolerated.

name: bifida ferment lysate
role: Supports skin barrier health and a balanced microbiome; often paired with other calming ingredients.
caution: Generally well tolerated.
